articles.title: Asian-American Deli Café Hestia Signs 8K-SF Lease at 570 Lexington Avenue
articles.narrative: Café Hestia, an Asian-American deli, has secured an 8,000-square-foot lease for 20 years at 570 Lexington Avenue in Manhattan, marking its fourth location in the borough. The space will serve as a new cafe and likely a catering facility. The landlord noted that the cafe's all-day dining concept and diverse offerings align with their strategy to bring lasting value to tenants and the surrounding neighborhood.

data_points.address: 570 Lexington Avenue, New York City, NY

tenants: Real Estate Board of New York
articles.market_intelligence: The average asking rent for the nearby retail corridor along Fifth Avenue from East 42nd to East 49th streets was $575 per square foot in the second quarter of 2026.

articles.title: Edgewood Capital Provides $28M Refi for Fort Lauderdale Condo Project
articles.narrative: Latitude Group has secured a $27.9 million refinancing loan for its newly completed 22-unit condominium project in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. Edgewood Capital provided the financing for The Terraces, which is expected to debut this fall. BayBridge Real Estate Capital arranged the transaction for the developer.

data_points.notable_features: Amenities include a fitness center, yoga studio, swimming pool, cabanas, and a community kitchen.
data_points.project_notes: The 2.2-acre development site was previously acquired in 2020 for $3.3 million. A $24.5 million construction loan was secured in June 2024 from Linkvest Capital.

articles.title: Decron Properties Buys 163-Unit Property in L.A.’s Miracle Mile for $114M
articles.narrative: Decron Properties has acquired a 163-unit mixed-use property in Los Angeles' Miracle Mile for $114 million, marking the firm's first acquisition in the city in nearly two years. The property, developed in 2010, includes residential units and fully leased ground-floor retail space. Decron's CEO noted that while the firm has focused on Sun Belt markets, Los Angeles remains a key target due to its undersupplied housing market and high barriers to new construction.

data_points.notable_features: Includes one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments and townhomes with amenities such as a pool, spa, resident lounge, private movie theater, and rooftop lounges.

articles.title: Corebridge Financial Refis Meatpacking Office Property With $293M Loan
articles.narrative: A joint venture between Aurora Capital Associates and William Gottlieb Real Estate has secured a $293 million fixed-rate loan from Corebridge Financial to refinance their mixed-use property at 40 10th Avenue in Manhattan's Meatpacking District. The 10-story building, completed in 2019, features a fully leased office component and a strong retail presence, reflecting sustained demand for high-quality, well-located workplaces in New York City's supply-constrained Meatpacking District. Walker & Dunlop negotiated the financing.

data_points.notable_features: The 10-story building features 112,241 square feet of office space and 46,176 square feet of retail, with substantial outdoor space.
data_points.project_notes: The property previously secured a $150 million loan from Deutsche Pfandbriefbank in June 2020 to refinance construction debt.

people.name: Dustin Stolly
people.title: Senior Managing Director, Capital Markets Institutional Advisory Team

articles.market_intelligence: The Meatpacking District is noted as one of Manhattan’s most supply-constrained office and retail submarkets.

articles.title: Stroller Brand Uppababy Relocates Store to 156 Montague Street in Brooklyn Heights
articles.narrative: Uppababy, a high-end baby gear brand, is relocating its Brooklyn retail and service hub to a larger 3,780-square-foot space at 156 Montague Street in Brooklyn Heights. The move from its previous Cobble Hill location will allow the company to enhance its product experience and personalized service for local families, capitalizing on the strong community of young families in Brooklyn Heights. The new location offers improved visibility and accessibility, which are key for family-focused retailers.

data_points.notable_features: Located in Brooklyn Heights, a neighborhood with a strong community of young and growing families, offering neighborhood density, visibility, and accessibility.

articles.market_intelligence: The average retail asking rent along nearby Fulton Street was $190 per square foot in 2025.

articles.title: Marcus & Millichap Brokers Sale of 645-Unit Self-Storage Facility in San Antonio
articles.narrative: Marcus & Millichap has brokered the sale of a 645-unit self-storage facility in San Antonio. The property, built in 2023 and previously operated by CubeSmart, was acquired by Public Storage, which has since rebranded the facility. The transaction involved a New Jersey-based limited liability company as the seller.

articles.title: WareSpace Opens 174,500 SF Industrial Facility in Plano
articles.narrative: WareSpace has opened a new 174,500-square-foot industrial facility in Plano, TX, designed to provide flexible workspace and shared amenities for small businesses and entrepreneurs. This facility caters to companies that require more space than a home garage but are not yet ready for a traditional industrial lease.

articles.title: Worth & Associates Acquires 108,116 SF Office Complex in San Antonio
articles.narrative: Worth & Associates has acquired The Commons at Concord Park, a 108,116-square-foot office complex in San Antonio. The locally based owner-operator plans to implement capital improvements to the property, which consists of four buildings with a range of suite sizes. Cushman & Wakefield represented the seller in the transaction.

data_points.address: 300 E Sonterra Blvd, San Antonio, TX
data_points.notable_features: Comprises four buildings with suites ranging from 1,254 to 9,790 square feet.

articles.title: Lee & Associates Negotiates 14,100 SF Industrial Lease in Richardson, Texas
articles.narrative: Lee & Associates has successfully negotiated a 14,100-square-foot industrial lease in Richardson, Texas. The transaction involved an entity operating as Dallas North Industrial LLC as the landlord and Battery Management Technology Corp. as the tenant. The property, located at 789 N. Grove Road, was built in 1983 and totals 54,471 square feet.

articles.title: Avison Young Arranges $115M in Agency Financing for Queens Apartment Building
articles.narrative: Avison Young has secured $115 million in Fannie Mae financing for a 301-unit apartment building in Long Island City, Queens. Wells Fargo provided the loan for the property, which is the second phase of the Eagle Lofts Collection development. The financing was arranged on behalf of the owner, Rockrose Development.

data_points.notable_features: Amenities include a spa, speakeasy sports parlor with bowling, golf simulator, ski simulator, rooftop pool, fitness center, children's playroom, and pet washing station. 30% of units are designated as affordable housing.
data_points.project_notes: Loan provided through Fannie Mae's Delegated Underwriting Service (DUS) program. This property represents Phase II of the Eagle Lofts Collection.

articles.title: Berkadia closes sale of two multifamily properties in Houston’s Midtown neighborhood
articles.narrative: Berkadia has brokered the sale of two multifamily properties, 220 and 230 W. Alabama, located in Houston's Midtown neighborhood. The 131-unit portfolio was sold by an affiliate of Realty Center Management, Inc. to Houston-based Fat Property. The transaction underscores the continued demand for urban core multifamily assets in Houston.

data_points.notable_features: Located in Midtown Houston, a vibrant and walkable urban district with convenient access to Downtown Houston and nearby amenities.

articles.title: CBRE closes sale of redevelopment land sites in Chicago’s Fulton market neighborhood
articles.narrative: CBRE has facilitated the sale of two redevelopment land sites in Chicago's Fulton Market neighborhood. Range Group acquired 1133 W. Kinzie, while another Chicago-based developer/investor purchased 1201 W. Kinzie. Both parcels were sold by North Carroll, LLC, and are slated for multifamily developments, reflecting the strong investment momentum in the area.

data_points.notable_features: Located near the intersection of Racine Avenue and Kinzie Street, offering convenient access to the Morgan CTA station and downtown Chicago.
data_points.project_notes: 1133 W. Kinzie is planned for a 109-unit multifamily development, and 1201 W. Kinzie is planned for a 66-unit multifamily development.

articles.market_intelligence: Fulton Market is recognized as one of the nation's premier mixed-use urban neighborhoods and a highly desirable development destination in Chicago, with significant new developments like Related Midwest's Sidley Austin-anchored office project highlighting its continued transformation and investment activity.

articles.title: EquiCap Commercial brokers sale of 472-unit storage center portfolio in Peoria and Bellevue
articles.narrative: EquiCap Commercial has brokered the sale of a two-property self-storage portfolio totaling 472 units across 73,680 net rentable square feet. The stabilized, income-producing assets are located in Peoria and Bellevue, Illinois.

articles.title: Fengate Asset Management, Mavrek Development celebrate groundbreaking of 25-story residential development in Chicago’s West Loop
articles.narrative: Fengate Asset Management and Mavrek Development have broken ground on Julep West Loop, a 25-story mixed-use residential development in Chicago's West Loop. The project will feature 380 residential units, including 76 affordable units, and over 21,500 square feet of commercial space, anchored by an international grocery store. This development addresses strong housing demand and limited new residential supply in the rapidly growing West Loop neighborhood, offering residents convenient access to major employment centers and amenities.

data_points.notable_features: Includes 76 affordable units, rooftop pool with cabanas, pickleball court, half-court basketball court, dog run, EV charging stations, and targets National Green Building Standard (NGBS) certification.
data_points.project_notes: Construction is expected to generate approximately 740,000 union construction labor hours and $69 million in income for Chicago's union construction workforce between 2026 and 2028. The investment is supported by an anchor commitment from the LiUNA Pension Fund of Central and Eastern Canada.

articles.title: Southwest-Inspired Cocktail Bar Setting Up Shop in South Street Seaport District
articles.narrative: Mesa Bar, a new Southwestern-inspired cocktail and wine bar, has signed a lease for a new location at 220 Front St. in New York City's South Street Seaport Historic District. The establishment, founded by Levent Cakir, will offer a creative cocktail program, curated wine list, cold beer, and bar snacks. The Durst Organization, the landlord, noted that Mesa Bar will enhance the diverse dining, retail, and hospitality experiences in the area.

data_points.address: 220 Front St, New York City, NY
data_points.notable_features: Located in the South Street Seaport Historic District.

articles.title: Pegasus Completes Project Management for Two LA Retail Developments
articles.narrative: Pegasus recently completed project management for two retail developments in Los Angeles. The projects included the first Raising Cane's location in Westwood Village and a new Honey Baked Ham franchise in Sherman Oaks. Pegasus served as the owner's project management advisor, guiding both projects from planning through completion, emphasizing thoughtful planning, clear communication, and disciplined execution.

articles.title: Downtown Brooklyn Development Site Fetches $84M
articles.narrative: Borough Developers has acquired the Bridge & Fulton Development Site in Downtown Brooklyn from ICER Real Estate for $83.5 million. The transaction, arranged by JLL Capital Markets, highlights strong investor confidence in Downtown Brooklyn and the demand for large-scale housing development opportunities. Preliminary plans for the site envision a four-building mixed-use development with ground-floor retail and residential units above.

data_points.address: 485 Fulton St. and 147 Lawrence St., Brooklyn, NY
data_points.notable_features: Located within an Inner Transit Zone with no parking requirement, offering development flexibility through the City of Yes program.
data_points.project_notes: Preliminary plans envision a four-building development comprising retail on the ground with residential above.

articles.title: Marcus & Millichap Closes Multifamily Sale in San Diego’s College East
articles.narrative: Marcus & Millichap has facilitated the sale of The Molokai Apartments, a 39-unit multifamily property in San Diego's College East neighborhood, for $11.2 million. The property garnered significant investor interest due to its spacious floor plans and desirable tenant amenities, including a private pool and secure access. The transaction highlights strong demand for well-appointed multifamily assets in the San Diego market.

data_points.notable_features: Units average over 800 square feet, significantly larger than area averages. Amenities include a private pool, secure access, storage, and off-street parking.

articles.title: Rhone Signs 40K-SF Headquarters Lease with RFR in Stamford
articles.narrative: Performance apparel brand Rhone has signed a 40,000-square-foot headquarters lease at 300 Atlantic St. in Stamford, CT, owned by RFR. The transaction will accommodate the brand's continued growth and is expected to house over 150 employees. The new headquarters will occupy the top two floors of the building, reflecting Rhone's expansion since its founding in 2014.

articles.title: Global Volatility Giving Boston Industrial Tenants Pause On Long-Term Deals
articles.narrative: Geopolitical tensions and elevated interest rates are significantly impacting the Boston industrial market, leading to increased vacancy rates and a preference among tenants for shorter-term lease agreements. This market dynamic suggests a cautious approach by businesses facing global economic uncertainties.

articles.title: Digital Media Firm Pivots To AI, Abandons $160M Fort Lauderdale Studio Project
articles.narrative: Napster has withdrawn from its planned $160 million movie studio project in Fort Lauderdale, opting instead to pivot its business strategy towards artificial intelligence. The development site will revert to its original developer, marking a significant change in the property's future.

data_points.project_notes: Napster has abandoned its plans for a movie studio project and is pivoting to AI.

articles.title: State Farm's 1.1M SF Suburban Atlanta Hub Put Up For Sale
articles.narrative: The State Farm towers, a prominent 1.1 million-square-foot office complex in suburban Atlanta, have been put up for sale. The property is fully leased, boasting a substantial remaining rent of $527 million, indicating strong long-term income potential for a prospective buyer.

data_points.project_notes: The property has $527 million in remaining rent.

articles.title: Data Center Energy Bill Stalls In Congress As Opponents Say It Lacked 'Real Teeth'
articles.narrative: A proposed bill aimed at regulating data center energy consumption and preventing spikes in energy bills has stalled in the Senate. Opponents criticized the legislation for lacking substantial enforcement mechanisms, leading to its failure to advance. This legislative setback could pose a political challenge for Republicans.
